about_the_game:
The Funnel is a narrative puzzle game mixing branching dialogue and challenging puzzle minigames. You have just been transferred to a new factory in a world where humanity has moved underground, but the details of your transfer don't seem to add up. Something is cracking in this perfectly structured world.

Who do you trust

Befriend your crew mates and help them out, betray their trust and inform the robot, or ignore everyone and stay focused on the gear boxes. The choice is yours. Everything you do, or don't do, will affect which narrative path your story takes.

Unique minigames with unique consequences

Your choices will not only affect your story, but also which minigames you experience. Different characters want help with different tasks after all, and even failing those tasks will lead to different story outcomes.

Discover the mysteries that underpin this strange world

Experience The Funnel’s unique world, diverging from our own timeline in the 1900s when a group of scientists in Old Philadelphia created the Funnel, a giant robotic structure that supposedly can average out the collective will of humanity. But why has the Funnel started appearing in your dreams?

content_descriptors.notes: Characters are electrocuted in a cartoonish fashion. There is some mild profanity. The drinking of alcohol is insinuated. Depending on the story path there is also the possibility of cartoonish violent and accidental deaths (There is no gore).

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 Or Better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX10 Compatible Cards/Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Due to the fixed camera nature of the game, the game currently only displays in 16:9 resolutions, and will letterbox if the monitor resolution is anything else.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Assemble gear boxes, get to know your crew, or escape the factory. Experience the unique underground steampunk world of The Funnel, where you may help or betray any of the people you meet. But don't fall behind on your gear boxes...
